caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with a curved front and four drawers, each equipped with two oval-shaped brass handles and a central keyhole. The chest is rendered in shades of brown, reflecting the wood grain, while the handles and keyholes are depicted in yellow-gold tones. The chest stands on four legs with the front legs featuring a curved cut-out design at the bottom. The top surface of the chest is flat with a slightly protruding edge, and there is a thin decorative band running along the top and bottom edges of the front face. The background is a plain, light beige color without any additional objects or details.
title: Chest of Drawers
